scripts.dev: node scripts/wrangler-config.mjs && pnpm --filter @cirrus/admin build && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: node scripts/wrangler-config.mjs --remote && pnpm --filter @cirrus/admin build && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/wrangler-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/wrangler-config.mjs --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
